videos.slide_title: Cold Plates Connect Chips to the Cooling Loop
videos.educational_rationale: A sectional heat path distinguishes heat conduction from fluid motion and keeps residual air cooling visible.
videos.visual_composition: Large schematic chip/TIM/cold-plate stack at left-center; paired supply/return hoses connect to a manifold at right. Short dotted upward heat traces show heat crossing solid interfaces; separate solid arrows identify coolant supply and return. A distinct residual-air path goes above other components. Supply paths and labels are blue; return paths and labels are red. Heat-transfer arrows retain amber and the structural palette is unchanged. The paired connection rectangles sit on the manifold-side supply and return segments.
videos.timing_status: Final WAV duration measured; finite master encoded within one frame. User-approved narration synchronization: play once and hold final picture. Phrase timings remain semantic estimates.

scenes.spoken_phrase_cue: Connections also need alignment, qualification and leak response.

videos.educational_rationale: Two closed loops make the separation of coolant circuits and the heat-transfer boundary immediately legible.
videos.visual_composition: Technology loop occupies left half, facility loop right half. A liquid-to-liquid heat exchanger sits centrally with two separate channels and a visible divider. Each loop closes back to its starting component. Heat crosses the divider through short neutral dotted arrows; no fluid path crosses it. Cooler external supply paths are blue, warmer external return paths red. Inside each isolated exchanger channel, the temperature gradient runs red at the top to blue at the bottom: technology coolant cools downward while facility fluid warms upward. A small relative-temperature key explains the color meaning. Technology circuit has the quoted subtitle “Secondary Loop”; Facility circuit has “Primary Loop”, centered below each circuit name and revealed with it.
videos.timing_status: Final WAV duration measured; finite master encoded within one frame. User-approved narration synchronization: play once and hold final picture. Phrase timings remain semantic estimates.

scenes.visual_action: Reveal independent facility circuit and heat-rejection endpoint; close the return route.

videos.slide_title: Telemetry Becomes Action Through a Controlled Feedback Path
videos.educational_rationale: The visual separates observation, policy, authorized action and verification, while making failure branches visible.
videos.visual_composition: Upper horizontal chain shows cooling condition, observation, policy and action; bottom lane returns to verification and escalation. An explicit freshness gate sits between telemetry and policy. Branches terminate in an escalation object, not a reset animation.
